name.full: LumiAgents — Lumiture's agent fleet in Teams

description.short: Ask Lumiture's agents about opportunities, resumes, tickets and finance.
description.full:
LumiAgents brings Lumiture's agent fleet into Teams.

Message the bot and it routes to the right agent:

• Beady — GovCon business development. SAM.gov opportunities, go/no-go assessments, RFI drafting.
• Angie — HR and recruiting. Résumé scoring, formatting, and blind-résumé export.
• Patch — IT and operations. Tickets, staffing requests, document ingest.
• Money — finance. Invoices, budgets, and financial reporting.

Routing is by keyword, so "any govcon opportunities this week?" reaches Beady and "score this résumé" reaches Angie. In a channel, the channel's name is used too, so a #govcon channel routes to Beady without being asked. When nothing in the message is decisive it goes to Patch.

Files can be attached: dropping a résumé PDF into the chat is a valid request on its own.

Each conversation keeps its own memory, so follow-up questions do not need restating. Anything the agents start appears as a run in the LumiAgents dashboard, where it can be watched and audited.
